title: Social and partner
blurb: Two people, one room, a band: the couple dances a city invents when it has a night off — from the Viennese ballroom to the Caribbean port, and the codes that decide who may ask whom.

items.s: Ballroom dance is a set of partner dances, which are enjoyed both socially and competitively around the world, mostly because of its performance and entertainment aspects.
Tango is a partner and social dance that originated in the 1880s along the Río de la Plata, the natural border between Argentina and Uruguay.
